claim_boundary: The affine system is exact for each enumerated first-leaf completion; a consistent rank-deficient second leaf is conservatively retained. Direct Sage S3 enumeration validates the rejection and unique-witness rules on 49 local cases. Count skipped domains, cache construction, span and affine field work, XORs, clauses and peak RSS; preserve failures and timeouts. CPU wall times here are exploratory. A stage diagnostic without verified ordinary relations and useful rank does not estimate natural yield or complete degree-131 IC work.
question: Can exact one-sided affine S3 feasibility reject a sparse second-pair domain earlier than Q1435 and recover an ordinary N53/N83 four-point relation on matched inputs?

factor_base.construction: all rational nonzero x of normal-basis weight at most w; both curve lifts; project by the exact curve cofactor; discard identity and deduplicate
factor_base.quotient_rule: {plus/minus sigma^j(P), j=0..n-1}; canonical key is smallest normal-basis x coordinate

field.basis_coordinates: bit i-1 is coefficient of gamma_i=zeta^i+zeta^-i, i=1..n
field.defining_modulus: symmetric subalgebra of F2[z]/(z^107-1), modulo sum(z^i, i=0..106)
field.element_encoding: nonnegative integer native ONB symmetric bit vector, normalized bit zero

point_decomposition.leaf_lift_gate: Tr(x+x^-1)=0 on y^2+xy=x^3+1; check each fully assigned leaf, forbid a failed x using full cube or maximal-weight positive support
point_decomposition.pair_guard_policy: weight-maximal positive support or full cube
point_decomposition.pair_links: pair0 external exact S3 roots; pair1 external exact roots plus symbolic factored S3 with XOR-to-CNF Tseitin chain

Choose the cheaper orientation when both qualify. At most 8192 affine columns per state; larger states leave SAT unchanged. An inconsistent system or unique overweight solution rejects that first-leaf completion; a consistent rank-deficient system stays unknown. Reject zero-feasible states or force an exact unique completion under all fixed leaf bits and the full second intermediate; charge XORs, field calls, skipped states, clauses, and memory
point_decomposition.partial_span_cache_policy: memoize every checked partial tuple; lazily build all pair-basis products and squares once, gamma columns for at most 64 exact intermediates, and coordinate-wise linear coefficients for at most 16384 exact pairs of intermediate and opposite fixed-one mask; if a table cap is reached compute uncached without changing the span result; charge construction and peak memory
point_decomposition.partial_span_filter: for each distinct actual SAT state with second-pair intermediate fixed, both partner leaves partial, at least one leaf with at most two Hamming-weight units left, and at most 18/24 free coordinates per leaf at N53/N83: reject when S3 constant is outside the F2 span of all linear and bilinear free-coordinate coefficients; emit a clause guarded by every fixed bit of both leaves and all bits of the second intermediate
point_decomposition.pinning_policy: archived full-lock witness with leaf1 and leaf3 unit pins removed; leaf0, leaf2, both intermediates and target selector remain pinned
point_decomposition.reverse_partner_root_propagation: for a fixed pair intermediate and one complete nonzero leaf, exact symmetric S3 roots constrain the partner; zero intermediate uses inverse; discard zero, weight above bound or non-lifting roots under full guards
point_decomposition.symbolic_pair1_activation: all n equations of S3(leaf2,leaf3,mid1)=0 are present before SAT decisions; exact external roots remain as a redundant model check and propagation rule
point_decomposition.target_coupled_root_propagation: when first pair intermediate and target selector are assigned, exact S3 roots constrain second pair intermediate under a full assignment guard; S3(0,t,z) uses z=t^-1
point_decomposition.termination_policy: CaDiCaL synchronous 60-second terminator plus one-million-conflict cap; 75-second process safeguard
